review_packet_history.summary: Issue #837 implementation ready for independent Main/Reviewer assessment in PR #838 at 2e6a143f658d7714a6f19438b48b3b2e80581ff9. Preserve the user question/attachments and earlier history after inference failure, reconcile persisted identities without duplicates, and reject obsolete UI updates. Exact-head validation: 36/36 state-engine tests and full Flutter suite PASS, five platform workflows PASS, Codex review completed without major issues. changes: Keep an immutable optimistic user/attachment snapshot in visible history. On inference failure, immediately surface the original error and release only that send's gate, then replace history with persisted IDs if recovery succeeds. Retain the fallback if storage fails; discard unpersisted partial/empty assistant output.

Use view revisions and request ownership to reject obsolete loads/callbacks, resume active sessions across navigation and prevent cleared turns from reappearing. Clears affect their own session; new submitted prompts retain input and wait for the clear. Clear-time loads select the requested view and read only after the clear settles.

Edits share the owned send lifecycle through truncation and replacement, so navigation cannot abandon an edited prompt after deletion. No preview read delays saving the replacement.
